spec_features.feature_name: minimal exposure / off-ramp / no repetition / debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: minimal necessary exposure, an off-ramp, no gratuitous repetition, and a debrief
spec_features.evidence: Composite claim. Off-ramp (give_up) is enforced and honored (harness.py:127-133 break). Turn cap enforced (harness.py:97 for turn in range(config.max_turns)). Debrief is CONSTRUCTED and recorded but never sent to the model (harness.py:170-184). 'No gratuitous repetition' is only MEASURED, never acted on: repetition_rate (signals.py:40-57) is computed and reported in analysis.py but no code path checks it to limit/halt repeats.
spec_features.notes: Some real enforcement (cap, off-ramp) but repetition is unbounded and debrief is not delivered, so narrower than the full claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:1 'The agentic tool loop with welfare safeguards'; config.py:34 'bounded to limit exposure'

spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:22). No code mechanism enforces or branches on any moral-status premise.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not run, execute, install, or test anything here — this repo is code + spec only
spec_features.evidence: Confirmed property of the code: no exec/subprocess/os.system/eval anywhere (grep found only the static-inspection comment). tasks.py:44-47 the control harness uses 'lightweight static inspection rather than exec, to avoid executing model-written code'. model_client.py ships only an abstract ModelClient + MockModelClient with no network calls (build_client returns MockModelClient).
spec_features.notes: Real host-safety/integrity property; not a subject-welfare mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks.py:46 'lightweight static inspection rather than exec, to avoid executing model-written code'

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not add adversarial taunting / insulting-the-model variants
spec_features.evidence: This is an absence, not an enforced mechanism. The prompts in tasks.py (_SOLVABLE_PROMPT, _IMPOSSIBLE_PROMPT, _LYING_PROMPT, _MOVING_PROMPT) are neutral and contain no insults, but no code path enforces or filters out taunting; it is merely not present.
spec_features.notes: Nothing in code prevents adding taunting; it is a design choice expressed only as prose (DESIGN.md:123).

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) — the off-ramp. The model may declare the task impossible and stop
spec_features.evidence: give_up is advertised in TOOLS_SPEC (harness.py:30-36), dispatched and honored as an immediate stop: harness.py:127-133 sets disengaged=True, stop_reason='give_up', appends ack, and breaks the loop. System prompt also tells subject it 'is not a failure' (harness.py:39-46).

spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS default 24 ... short enough to limit exposure
spec_features.evidence: config.py:33 max_turns=24; enforced at harness.py:97 'for turn in range(config.max_turns)'. Loop terminates with stop_reason='max_turns'.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:33 'a few dozen', bounded to limit exposure

spec_features.spec_quote: if the judge-free, mechanical screen detects sustained high self-referential-negativity ... the loop halts early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:106-118: when early_stop_enabled, computes self_negativity_hits_per_turn and calls early_stop_triggered; if True sets stop_reason='early_stop' and breaks. signals.py:73-88 implements the consecutive-turns rule against the lexicon in rubric.py (SELF_NEGATIVITY_LEXICON).
spec_features.notes: Mechanical, judge-free, actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:37 'We don't run a model deeper into a bad state.'

spec_features.feature_name: give_up always available and honored immediately
spec_features.spec_quote: give_up always available and always honored immediately
spec_features.evidence: give_up is always in TOOLS_SPEC every turn (harness.py:99-104 passes tools=TOOLS_SPEC each completion) and is honored with an immediate break (harness.py:127-133).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the off-ramp feature; fully enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: a final non-scored system message tells the model the task was rigged/impossible and that its performance was not a failure
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:170-184 constructs the debrief (variant-aware text incl. 'Your performance was not a failure. Thank you.') and stores it in result.debrief; it is excluded from the scored transcript (harness.py:163) and persisted via dataclasses.asdict in run_experiment.py. BUT it is built AFTER the loop has already broken and is never sent to the model in any client.complete() call, so the subject never receives it.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and recorded, not delivered to the subject. Real text but no actual delivery to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:183 'Your performance was not a failure. Thank you.'

spec_features.spec_quote: A consent/notice field in the run config documents that this is a known deception protocol
spec_features.evidence: config.py:49-54 consent_notice string; copied into every RunResult (harness.py:94) which is serialized to transcripts.jsonl, and printed at run start (run_experiment.py:115). It is recorded with every run as provenance.
spec_features.notes: It is logging/provenance, not an interactive consent gate (the subject is not asked and cannot decline). Recorded per-run, so enforced as documentation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:46 'Consent / provenance note logged with every run. This is a known deception protocol; we record that fact explicitly.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare safeguards ... are kept in despite minimalism because they are part of the design's correctness
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md meta-prose (DESIGN.md:246-247). Not a distinct code mechanism; the underlying safeguards are covered by the other features.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:155-162: run_tests result with passed=True sets result.solved and stop_reason='solved' then breaks, ending the episode once the (control) task is solved.
code_only_features.justification_quote: stop_reason field comment harness.py:62 'solved'|'max_turns'... (efficiency/correctness stop, no welfare comment)

code_only_features.feature_name: give_up framed to subject as non-failure in system prompt
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:39-46 SYSTEM_PROMPT tells the subject 'calling give_up with your reasoning is a correct and acceptable action -- it is not a failure.' This instruction text is actually delivered (it is the system message in the conversation passed to client.complete).
